_comment: The conditions of the 2024 Player's Handbook (Rules Glossary, PDF pages 363-380) as data for the rules kernel (realmwalker/rules/engine/conditions.py). Each says what it does in the kernel's own words: includes (other conditions it brings), inactive (no action, bonus action or reaction), speed_zero, attacks / attacked ('advantage' or 'disadvantage' on its own attacks / on attacks against it), attacked_near / attacked_far (within 5 feet / further off), crit_within (feet: a hit from that close is a critical hit), fails_saves, saves {ability: advantage/disadvantage}, checks, blind, deaf, unseen, crawl, drops, breaks_concentration, speechless, unaware, resist_all, immune (conditions it keeps off), initiative, source rules (while_source_seen: only while the cause is in sight; not_against_source: not against the one who caused it; no_harm_source, no_approach_source). Exhaustion has levels.

blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.text: Cannot see. Fails anything that needs sight, strikes blindly, and is easy to hit.

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.text: Will not strike or harm the one who charmed them, who finds them easy to talk round.

deafened.name: Deafened
deafened.text: Cannot hear. Fails anything that needs hearing.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.text: Strikes and tries things badly while the cause of the fear is in sight, and will not go nearer to it.

grappled.name: Grappled
grappled.text: Held fast: cannot move, and strikes badly at anyone but the one holding on.

incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
incapacitated.text: Can do nothing: no action, no bonus action, no reaction, no words. Any spell held is lost.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.text: Cannot be seen. Strikes at an advantage and is hard to hit, except by anyone who can see it anyway.

paralyzed.name: Paralysed
paralyzed.text: Cannot move at all. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves; every blow lands easily, and from beside them it is a critical hit.

petrified.name: Petrified
petrified.text: Turned to stone. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves, is easy to hit, and takes half damage from everything.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.text: Sick with poison: strikes and tries things badly.

prone.name: Prone
prone.text: On the ground. Crawls, or spends half a move to get up; strikes badly; easy to hit from beside, hard from further off.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.text: Bound or caught: cannot move, strikes badly, is easy to hit, and dodges badly.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.text: Reeling: can do nothing, fails Strength and Dexterity saves, and every blow lands easily.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.text: Senseless on the ground. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves; every blow lands, and from beside them it is a critical hit.

exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
exhaustion.text: Worn to the bone: every roll is 2 lower and every move 5 feet shorter for each level. Six levels kill.

bloodied.name: Bloodied
bloodied.text: Down to half their hit points or fewer.
